text:
About ImagineArt

We're redefining how the world creates and designs.
ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We've scaled faster than most funded startups — with zero outside funding.

100M+ social impressions

Built and shipped our own image generation model, now ranked #3 globally for photo realism

No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world — and we're just getting started.
We're looking for an Agent Infrastructure Engineer to own Superagent, our core agent harness that powers conversations, tool calls, and multi-step agentic workflows across our AI products.
This is a deep systems and infrastructure role — not prompt engineering and not simply wrapping model APIs. You'll work on the core orchestration loop, tool-calling infrastructure, context and memory management, streaming, retries, evaluation, observability, and performance.
Key Responsibilities

Own the architecture, development, and evolution of Superagent, our core agent harness.

Design and optimize the agent execution loop for latency, reliability, token efficiency, cost, and task completion.

Build and improve core harness systems including context management, memory/state handling, tool routing, function schemas, structured outputs, retries, and error recovery.

Build and maintain agent evaluation infrastructure to measure quality and guide engineering decisions with data.

Integrate and benchmark multiple LLM providers and models, evaluating performance, cost, reliability, and capabilities.

Implement performance optimizations such as caching, batching, parallel tool execution, and prompt/context compression.

Build deep observability and instrumentation across agent runs, including tracing, logging, metrics, and regression detection.

Extend and customize underlying agent frameworks when existing abstractions are insufficient.

Build reliable integrations with evolving AI and tool ecosystems.

Work closely with product engineering teams to expose clean abstractions while keeping harness complexity behind the platform.

Debug and resolve complex issues across non-deterministic, distributed, and model-driven systems.

Required Skills & Qualifications

4+ years of experience in software engineering, backend engineering, or systems infrastructure.

Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.

Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-based agents in production.

Strong understanding of tool calling, function schemas, context limits, structured outputs, model failures, and unreliable LLM behavior.

Experience with at least one agent framework such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or a custom/homegrown agent harness.

Strong understanding of agent orchestration and multi-step workflows.

Experience building or working with evaluation suites, benchmarks, A/B testing, or other measurement systems for AI products.

Strong understanding of concurrency, caching, profiling, performance optimization, and latency/cost tradeoffs.

Experience working with LLM APIs and production AI infrastructure.

Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills, especially for complex and non-deterministic systems.

Passionate about technology, self-driven, and proactive with a strong builder mindset.

Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills

Contributions to open-source agent frameworks, LLM tooling, or AI infrastructure.

Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or long-term memory systems for AI agents.

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool-integration standards.

Experience with LLM inference infrastructure, model routing, rate limits, fallbacks, or high-volume model APIs.

Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, DSPy, or similar AI infrastructure frameworks.

Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.

title: Data QA Engineer - Remote
text:
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.
Role Overview
Data QA is how we make sure the data we deliver is right before the customer sees it. As a Data QA Engineer, you will check the data our spiders and AI-assisted projects produce against what the customer asked for, find what is wrong and tell the team exactly what you found.
Quality assurance is more useful as a question asked at the start than a gate at the end. Is this requirement testable and how would we know if it were wrong? Part of this role is asking that question early, so problems are fixed before they reach the customer.
Key Responsibilities

Turn customer scraping and data requirements into a clear test approach and own QA from the start on new projects.

Combine exploratory manual and visual testing with automated tests where automation pays for itself.

Run test cycles on extracted data and report the results clearly.

Write up defects with enough detail that a developer can reproduce and fix them without a conversation.

Use descriptive statistics, summaries and charts to show how good the data is: completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift.

Produce test reports and quality scores that give the team, and the customer where needed, a true picture.

Say what was tested, what was not, and what risk that leaves.

Work with project managers and clients to clear up unclear or untestable requirements before QA begins.

Feed into our test automation framework, with a focus on coverage and performance.

Suggest and take ownership of improvements to QA process and tooling, including browser add-ons, spreadsheet add-ons and UI-based test automation tools.

Work with QA leadership, project managers and developers, with minimal supervision.

Requirements

5+ years in a QA Engineer or similar role - testing software or data.

Python preferred language - Pandas and Jupyter for data analysis and validation.

SQL: basic to intermediate queries, and comfort with at least one relational database and its tools.

A solid grasp of web technologies and protocols: HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP and CSS.

Experience writing tests against HTTP/REST APIs.

Proactive and detail-oriented QA professional with a strong sense of ownership over project quality.

Fast learner adept at rapidly understanding complex project domain requirements and adapting to new technologies.

Leveraging AI and LLM tools to optimize test case generation and accelerate data validation processes.

Good test case design and test data management.

Experience working in an agile team (Scrum or Kanban) alongside developers.

An understanding of data quality concepts such as completeness, accuracy, consistency and drift.

Strong attention to detail, and the confidence to hold the quality line under delivery pressure.

Clear written and spoken communication in English.

Nice to Have

title: DevSecOps Engineer
text:
ABOUT ATLYS

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.



THE ROLE

We're looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to own the foundations that keep Atlys fast, reliable and secure.

Not someone who simply keeps servers running or closes tickets from a scanner. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure and security as products: who designs systems that are secure by default, automates away toil, and gives every engineer a paved road to ship safely.

Few companies handle data as sensitive as ours. Passports, financial documents, photographs and identity records flow every day between travellers, partners and government systems across 127 countries. You'll own the cloud infrastructure, security posture and reliability of the platform that processes it, and make sure it scales as we grow.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to pass the next audit, but how to build systems that are fundamentally hard to break.



THE JOB

 - Own our cloud infrastructure. Build and run scalable AWS/GCP infrastructure with Kubernetes and make deployments repeatable and fast.

 - Data security. Design access controls, audit logging across internal tooling and cloud infrastructure for PIIs like passports and financial documents, in line with compliance and data security

 - Secure the supply chain. Add SAST, DAST and dependency and container scanning to CI/CD, run vulnerability management and pen tests

 - Vulnerability Discovery: Find, validate and fix security gaps - business logic flaws, authorization issues, authentication bypasses, injection vulnerabilities


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

You'll likely thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 4–6 years of experience in infrastructure, DevOps, SRE or security engineering roles, ideally at a fast-growing product company handling sensitive or regulated data.

 - Have deep hands-on experience with any public cloud, Linux, networking, Docker and Kubernetes

 - Have a strong grounding in security fundamentals including but not limited to OWASP Top 10 and cloud security best practices and have applied them in production, not just on paper.

 - You can own security gaps in application layer and can validate and fix them yourself across the tech stack

 - Take ownership end to end. You make pragmatic trade-offs between security, speed and developer experience. You explain risk clearly and bring engineers along rather than acting as a gatekeeper.

 - Prior web/backend development experience is nice to have.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.

Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.

 - Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.

 - Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

 - Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.

This is a high-impact role at the center of NVIDIA's Zero Trust security journey — one that combines deep technical ownership with the opportunity to shape how a world-class technology company secures its identity infrastructure! Working alongside multi-functional teams, this position focuses on designing and implementing robust security policies and access controls, and providing technical mentorship on infrastructure improvements, third-party integrations, and platform upgrades across the organization.
This role holds accountability for the strategy, roadmap, and operations of our identity management and governance — ensuring tight alignment with our broader Zero Trust initiatives. A key part of the work involves spotting process gaps, implementing improvements, and establishing engineering guidelines that set the standard for the entire team. Specific responsibilities include:
Implementing identity security capabilities such as SSO, conditional access, MFA, and privileged access.

Managing vendor relationships to resolve issues and deliver new platform features.
